cards.title: Candidates Are Pre-Assessed
cards.description: Every candidate in our ICT, marketing, engineering, and hospitality pools has been screened for work history, skills assessment eligibility, and visa pathway viability before we refer them to any employer.

cards.title: Legal Partner in the Same Office
cards.description: Insight Idea's lawyers and migration agents work alongside our team at our Docklands office. There is no handoff gap between career placement and visa lodgement — both happen in parallel.

cards.title: Full Compliance Tracking Throughout Visa Validity
cards.description: Our CRM tracks each sponsored worker's milestone dates and 482/PR status. You will not miss a notification window or compliance deadline — all flagged well in advance.

cards.title: Completely Transparent Fees
cards.description: We provide a fully itemised fee structure before signing — government fees, SAF levy, and service fees all listed. No surprises after the process begins.

cards.title: Verified Sponsoring Employer Partners
cards.description: Our employer network holds current, verified 482 or 186 sponsorship eligibility. We have placed candidates across ICT, accounting, marketing, and engineering with employers who sponsor genuinely.

cards.title: Chinese-Speaking Team
cards.description: Many of our clients are most comfortable communicating in Mandarin. Our team includes fluent Mandarin and English speakers — ensuring nothing is lost in translation for either employer or candidate.
